question: What price per kilogram does the review give for ZrO2 coating precursors?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(lower(text), '(price|\$|usd|per kg|/kg|kilo|cost)') ORDER BY page, top

SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%zro%' AND (lower(text) LIKE '%cost%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%precursor%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%$%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%kg%') ORDER BY page, top
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%kg%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%per kilo%' OR text LIKE '%$%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%price%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%zirconium%' ORDER BY page, top
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE page IN (5,7,8) AND kind IN ('line') AND (lower(text) LIKE '%precursor%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%zro%') ORDER BY page, top
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(text, '(USD|€|£|¥|yuan|dollar|\$\s?\d|per kg|/kg|kg-1|kg−1|kg\^)') OR lower(text) LIKE '%per kg%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%/ kg%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE page IN (5,7) AND kind='line' AND id IN ('p5.L88','p5.L89','p5.L90','p5.L91','p5.L92','p7.L1') OR id LIKE 'p7.T1%' ORDER BY id
